title: Prospective flux-regime equivalence test for dynamic-top temporal certification

depends_on.RM16: provider valid; 8.64 s raw dynamic-top Reference-Richards solve converges
depends_on.Reference_temporal_indicator: currently admitted only for explicit fixed-flux top boundary

source_observation: At the frozen RM14 origin the dynamic-top provider is in FLUX regime with qtop=-36 cm/day, zero ponding and zero runoff. The raw 8.64-second solve converges.
question: For the exact converged 8.64-second RM14 trajectory, is the dynamic-top flux-regime solve physically and numerically equivalent to the already-supported explicit fixed-flux qtop=-36 cm/day solve strongly enough to justify a narrowly bounded temporal-certificate extension?
tests: Solve one raw Reference-Richards attempt with the dynamic-top provider and one independent raw attempt with the existing explicit fixed-flux provider from the identical accepted origin.
Use identical numerical settings and independent solver workspaces.
Compare solver status, top flux, bottom flux, candidate pressure heads, water contents and ponding state.
Evaluate the dynamic-top provider again at the converged candidate endpoint and require FLUX regime, qtop=-36 cm/day, zero runoff and zero candidate ponding.
Record bit identity where possible and strict absolute maxima for state differences.
decision_rules: If all equivalence criteria pass, permit a separate RM18 preregistration for a narrowly guarded temporal-indicator extension that treats only this verified dynamic FLUX regime as explicit-flux equivalent.
If state or flux equivalence fails, do not extend the temporal certificate; investigate the dynamic boundary derivative/state dependence instead.
RM17 itself changes no temporal-indicator code and admits no production behavior.
prohibitions: Do not modify temporal indicator code in RM17.
Do not relax solver or equivalence tolerances after execution.
Do not generalize to dynamic HEAD regime, ponding, runoff, evaporation, precipitation or snowmelt.
Do not rerun the three-model triangle from RM17 alone.
